sources.title: UniFi Access Point | Releases | Ubiquiti Community

articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Overview
This release is promoted to Official/Stable release channel for these models:


U7-Pro-Max, U7-Pro-Wall, U7-In-Wall, U7-Lite, U7-Mesh - May 29, 2026
U7-Pro - June 4, 2026

Bugfixes

Fixed WiFi dropping when Wireless Meshing is disabled and the gateway is unreachable.

Additional information
INFO: U7-LR model support will be added in upcoming releases.
----
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
UniFi Console Support File (as private attachment)
articles.title: UniFi Access Point (all U7 and E7 models) 8.6.11

articles.author: UI-Edmundas
articles.description:
Overview
This release is promoted to Official/Stable release channel for these models:

U7-Pro-XG, U7-Pro-XGS, U7-Pro-XG-Wall, U7-Outdoor, U7-Pro-Outdoor, E7, E7-Campus, E7-Audience - May 18, 2026

Improvements

Added DNS Assistance.
Improved delivery of broadcast DHCP offers to wireless clients.
Improved client connectivity.
Improved stability of mesh links.
Improved AP stability.

Bugfixes

Fixed DHCP failures for default network EAP/PPSK clients.
Fixed an issue where mDNS/multicast service discovery could break after configuration changes or AP reboot.
Fixed multicast streams sometimes not reaching wired clients on non-default VLANs.
Fixed IPv6 connectivity issues on PPSK SSIDs after configuration changes or with multicast filtering enabled.
Fixed hidden SSIDs appearing in Wi-Fi scan results.
Fixed guest portal showing a blank page for clients.
Fixed 10 Gbps ports not passing traffic after reboot or link events.

Additional information
INFO: U7-LR model support will be added in upcoming releases.
----
If you encounter any issues with this release, please provide us with some details on your setup and include the below information:

AP model(s)
Previous AP release version
UniFi Network application version
UniFi Console Support File (as private attachment)
